_source: IICE Innovation Club and Startup Studio (Lab-to-Market) student entrepreneurship pathway
name: Student pre-incubation
forWhom: IISER Bhopal BS, BS-MS, Integrated PhD, and PhD students translating thesis research or competition prototypes into pre-startups.
includes: Access to IICE co-working zones, brainstorming rooms, and maker/prototyping benches
Hands-on Startup Studio bootcamps on problem validation, customer discovery, and pitch deck design
Dual mentorship pairing an IISER Bhopal faculty advisor with an industry or alumni entrepreneur
Pathway to DST NIDHI-EIR fellowship and formal company incorporation under the Culture stage
terms: Zero rental fee for enrolled IISER Bhopal students during the pre-incubation validation phase.
